properties.name: openoil_booms
properties.cwl:
cwlVersion: v1.2
$namespaces:
  s: https://schema.org/
$graph:
- class: CommandLineTool
  id: openoil_booms
  baseCommand:
  - python
  - /opt/headless.py
  inputs:
    lat:
      type: float
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --lat
    lon:
      type: float
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --lon
    radius:
      type: int
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --radius
    start_time:
      type: string
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --start_time
    duration_hours:
      type: int
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --duration_hours
    number:
      type: int?
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --number
    oil_type:
      type: string?
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --oil_type
    total_mass_kg:
      type: int?
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --total_mass_kg
    density:
      type: float?
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --density
    viscosity:
      type: float?
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --viscosity

      type: string?
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --oil_source
    reader_ocean:
      type: string?
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --reader_ocean
    reader_wave:
      type: string?
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --reader_wave
    reader_wind:
      type: string?
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --reader_wind
    time_step:
      type: int?
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --time_step
    time_step_output:
      type: int?
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --time_step_output
    boom:
      type: string[]?
      doc: null
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --boom
  outputs:
    map:
      type: File
      doc: null
      outputBinding:
        glob: map.png
    result:
      type: File
      doc: null
      outputBinding:
        glob: results.nc
    simulation:
      type: File
      doc: null
      outputBinding:
        glob: simulation.mp4
    simulation_currents:
      type: File
      doc: null
      outputBinding:
        glob: initial_simulation_with_currents.mp4
    statistics:
      type: File
      doc: null
      outputBinding:
        glob: statistics.json
  requirements:
    NetworkAccess:
      networkAccess: true
    ResourceRequirement: {}
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: iliad-repository.inesctec.pt/openoil-booms:0.1.0
